properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): a test COLLECTION error recorded as `failing` produces "did not work as designed". The vocabulary CAN say "did not run" (Verification.status `blocked`, `skipped`), but `blocked` raises no gap. The automated route cannot produce it either: reconcile_verification takes only passed/failed/skipped, and tools/run_to_files.py maps a JUnit <error> to failed. A fourth shape of the one-status class
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-02, triaging art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02, tool friction 3. Triage agent C, dev_reflow2 hub.

① OBSERVED, the reporter's words: "A Verification recording a test collection error (no test body ran) produces failing_verification prose saying the part 'did not work as designed', which overstates the run." The report does not say whether `failing` was set by hand or by a reconcile.

② PRECEDENT: the class is fact:root-cause-a-run-has-one-status-and-its-qualification-reaches-no-rollup-2026-09-28: one machine-read outcome per run, with the qualification left in `findings`. Siblings:
- dec:idea-a-run-can-pass-with-its-exceptions-stated (open);
- fact:sighting-3-a-check-with-three-of-four-evidence-parts-measured-reads-blocked-2026-09-29.
This is the error-not-failure shape of the same class.

⑤ MEASURED, reflow2-mcp 0.77.0 --call on a scratch store. Logs: measure.log, g5-gaps-*.txt and g5-loop-blocked.txt in /home/ajs7/.claude/jobs/fa666a94/tmp/triage-C/.
- A capability verified by a check recorded `failing`, with findings "pytest collection error: ImportError in conftest.py; 0 tests ran", made detect_gaps say: "The check "parser test suite" was failing when it last ran, at 2026-10-02, so "Parser reads config files" did not work as designed then."
- The same check set to `blocked` with the same findings: NO gap about the check or the capability. Only loop_status's verifications digest lists it under `attention`, as status blocked.

③④ CODE, origin/main:
- detect.rs ~4161: the prose is keyed on status=failing. The findings text is never read, and it hedges only on last_run_at.
- schema/verify.yaml: status [planned, passing, failing, skipped, blocked, superseded], with no description of what `blocked` means.
- verify.rs OBSERVED_OUTCOMES = passed/failed/skipped, and reconcile maps failing↔failed.
- tools/run_to_files.py from_junit: `if case.find("failure") … or case.find("error") …: outcome = "failed"`. pytest reports a collection error as <error>, so a run fed back by file records a check that never executed as failing.

⑥ THE CLASS: the vocabulary distinguishes "ran and failed" from "could not run". The two routes that matter do not:
- the converter and the reconcile collapse error into failed;
- the detector treats blocked as nothing to say and failing as proof.
So the honest status is quiet, and the dishonest one is loud.

UNDER MCP: identical. These are core detectors and the same tools.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: which route the reporter used. Whether a `blocked` check should raise its own gap ("could not run, so nothing is known") is a design question for the owner, not answered here.
